Put an app on EzYourLife

Bring a web app you built. Test it in a live preview, send it for review, and it goes live after the EzYourLife team approves it. This guide walks through every screen.

Before you start

Developer

An EzYourLife account, and your app as one HTML file up to 10 MB. No file yet? Claude can build it from your project.

EzYourLife team

An admin account. Only an admin can set the credits per use, the developer's share, and press Approve.

Screenshots. They are real screens from the production build of this code, captured with a sample app called Tip Splitter and test data. Names, emails and the 100-credit balance are samples, not live records.

Send an app with Claude

This is the easiest route for big projects. Claude reads your code, changes it to follow EzYourLife's rules, builds one file, and sends it. Nothing goes live until an admin approves.

1

Add the connector to Claude

In Claude's connector settings, add a custom connector named EzYourLife with this address, then sign in with your EzYourLife account. It works on any Claude plan, including Free.

https://cmwnjexfpcfpoeyemxhb.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp

On a paid plan you can also add the ezyourlife-developer plugin. It carries the step-by-step skill, so Claude follows the same routine every time. On Team plans an owner adds it once for everyone.

2

Give Claude your project

Attach the project or a zip, or point Claude at a GitHub repository.

Put my app on EzYourLife. The code is in github.com/me/my-app. It is a bill splitter for restaurants.

Claude will ask for what the store needs: name, one-line description, category, support email.

3

Claude adapts the code

  • Removes API keys, AI calls, logins and payments.
  • Makes saved data work inside the sandbox.
  • Switches to hash routing and checks the phone layout.
  • Builds everything into one HTML file.

At the end it lists what it removed and what now behaves differently, for example "your saved lists last only while the app is open".

4

Claude sends the file

Big files go the way that works from where Claude runs. From claude.ai or Cowork it pushes the built file to GitHub and EzYourLife pulls that exact commit. From Claude Code on a computer it uses a one-time upload link, valid for one hour and one file. Small files are sent directly. In every case the admin later sees where the file came from.

Private GitHub repos. An admin has to add a read-only GitHub token as the EZYL_GITHUB_TOKEN secret. Without it, use a public repo or the upload link.
5

Claude runs the checks and gives you a preview link

Open the link and try the app yourself. When you are happy, tell Claude to send it for review. Claude never sends without your word.

Or use the web page

Everything Claude does is also available at ezyourlife.com/developer.

1

Create the app

Type the app name. The web address fills in from it. It becomes /tool/dev-your-name and cannot be changed later. Press Create app.

2

Upload the app file

Press Replace file (or Upload file the first time) and pick your HTML file, up to 10 MB. Big files are sent in parts with a progress bar. You can also paste or edit the HTML directly.

3

Fill in the store listing

Name, a one-line description (20 to 160 characters), a full description (at least 40), category, filter types and a support email. Press Save listing. The team may tidy the wording before it goes live.

4

Run the checks and try the preview

Press Run checks. The server reads your file and reports on each rule. Anything marked Must fix blocks sending. Look items go to the admin with your app.

The live preview runs your real app in the same locked frame the store uses. Switch between Phone and Desktop, reload it, or open it full screen. Previewing costs no credits.

5

Send for review

Press Send version 1 for review. The version is now locked and fingerprinted, so the admin tests the exact file you tested. To change anything, withdraw it first. A live app is never edited in place: saving a change starts the next version, and the current one keeps running until the new one is approved.

On a phone

The editor and the preview both work at phone width.

For the EzYourLife team

Open /admin/developer-apps, or press Review queue on the developer home. Only admins see it.

1

Open the waiting app

The left list shows apps waiting, oldest first. The card shows the listing, the developer's email, the file size, where the file came from, and a fingerprint of the exact file. Read the checks report, then try the app in the preview.

2

Set credits and the developer's share

Only your team decides these. Enter Credits per use (1 to 100) and the Developer share (0 to 90%). The line underneath shows the split on the worst case: the ₹999 influencer kit with 50% commission. In the example, 2 credits earn ₹0.22, of which the developer gets ₹0.06 and EzYourLife keeps ₹0.15.

3

Approve and publish, or send it back

Approve and publish is one click. It adds the app to the store and sets its price. It shows in the store within about 10 minutes because of the catalogue cache. To send it back instead, write what needs to change and press Ask for changes, or Don't accept. The developer sees your note.

4

Take an app down, or put it back

The All apps tab lists every developer app with its credits and share. Take down removes it from the store at once. Nothing is deleted, and Put back restores it.

What visitors see

The app is a normal store page at /tool/dev-your-name. The visitor sees the credits per use and presses Start. That charges through the same path as every other EzYourLife app, and one use lasts 30 minutes.

The checks

They run on EzYourLife's server, so a developer's own tools cannot fake the result.

CheckWhat it looks forIf it complains
App fileOne real HTML fileMust fix Put CSS and JavaScript inside the file.
SizeUp to 10 MBOver 2 MB is a Look (slow on phones). Over 10 MB is a Must fix.
Fits phonesA viewport tagAdd <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
No keys or passwordsAPI keys, tokens, private keysMust fix Remove them. If a key was ever committed, rotate it.
No AI callsOpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and similar hostsMust fix Rewrite without AI, or drop the feature.
No own paymentsRazorpay, Stripe, PayPal and similarMust fix EzYourLife charges credits for every use.
Outside addressesOther hosts the app callsLook The admin reviews the list.
Browser storagelocalStorage, cookies, IndexedDBLook Blocked in the sandbox. Wrap in try/catch.
Stays in its framewindow.top, parent.locationLook Remove it. It is blocked anyway.
Store listingName, descriptions, categoryMust fix Fill the missing fields.
Unique name and similar appsSame name, or 34% or more words in commonA same name is a Must fix. Similar apps go to the admin to judge.

If something fails

What you seeWhat to do
Pages show "not set up"The database files are applied. Push to main (Vercel deploys) so the site has the new pages, then reload.
Claude does not list the dev_* toolsThe mcp function needs the new deploy. Open …/functions/v1/sitemap: if it still shows phase0-b the function is old; it should show devapps-2. Redeploy, then reconnect the connector.
Import from a private repo says not foundAdd the EZYL_GITHUB_TOKEN secret (read-only, Contents: read), or make the repo public, or use the upload link.
"This version is waiting for review"Withdraw it from the editor to change it.
"The app changed after its checks"Run the checks again, then send.
Upload key not recognisedKeys last one hour and work for one file. Ask Claude for a new upload link.
Preview is blankOpen the browser console. Usually the app reads localStorage without try/catch, or loads a second file that was not inlined.

Limits for now

  • One HTML file per app, no backend of its own, no AI.
  • Camera, microphone, location and notifications are blocked.
  • No payouts ledger yet. The share is recorded per app, and payouts come in a later phase.

Technical reference for the team: docs/developer-apps.md in the repo.
